title: Quarterly assortment review — 214 active SKUs
narrative: Realify will propose the move set and wait for you. Nothing reaches a channel without your approval.

approve.blocked_reason: Approval happens at the decide stage.

approve_selected.blocked_reason: Approval happens at the decide stage.

modify.blocked_reason: Modification is not available at this stage.

send_back.blocked_reason: Sending back is not available at this stage.

snooze.blocked_reason: This proposal has no deadline to defer.

policy.label: GMROI target
policy.why: Gross margin return on inventory investment, measured per SKU across 90 days of true CM.

policy.label: Capital ceiling
policy.why: Total assortment capital. This review may rebalance inside the ceiling but never raise it.

policy.label: Exit-rate cap per quarter
policy.why: Protects channel ranking and review velocity from a mass delist. Counted on active SKUs at cycle start.

roles.name: Hero
roles.def: Top demand and top margin. Protect stock and price.

roles.name: Core
roles.def: Steady demand at acceptable margin. The base of the range.

roles.name: Margin Driver
roles.def: Below-average demand, high CM. Earns its shelf on margin.

roles.name: Traffic Driver
roles.def: High demand, thin CM. Earns its place by pulling volume.

roles.name: Supporting
roles.def: Low demand, low margin. Reviewed every quarter.

roles.name: Exit Candidate
roles.def: Below GMROI target for two consecutive quarters.
